'''November 2000 Melbourne tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 20 November 2000. [[Stuart Jones]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1490">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-24-melbourne-11-20-2000d1490/ melbourne-11-20-2000], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 24 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-24-melbourne-11-20-2000d1490/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Stuart Jones]]
